description: Fetch webhook endpoint configuration by ID.
name: shipmail_get_webhook

allowed_senders.description: Addresses and domains message.received is limited to. Null when every sender is delivered.

authenticated_senders_only.description: True when message.received is skipped for senders that did not pass DMARC.

has_authorization.description: True when deliveries carry an Authorization header. The value is never returned.

has_standard_webhooks_secret.description: True when deliveries carry Standard Webhooks signatures from a stored signing secret. The secret is never returned.

include_reply_text.description: True when message.received deliveries carry reply_text.

title: Get Webhook
